builds.name: Definitely Doing Her Best
builds.desc:
Amelia is one of the speedier Armor units out there, so why not try and use that to our advantage?
Amelia's Prf, the Grado Poleax, is really useful in giving her more Spd and Def. The skill's effect will come into play essentially every time thanks to Armor March. Also, due to Grado Poleax having a Slaying Axe effect built into it, Aether now has a cooldown of 4, which will allow her to proc it faster and keep her HP above the 50% threshold for Special Fighter.
Distant counter allows for dealing with those pesky ranged foes. Nothing really new here.
Special Fighter has some potential with Amelia thanks to her decent Spd for an armored unit. This way, she can proc Aether much faster, which works well when it comes to Special Fighter's HP threshold.
Armor March is a great way to mobilize your armored team, and is also a quick and eash way to activate Amelia's Prf effect.
The seal is always flexible, but I would recommend skills that allow Amelia to get an edge on her Spd stat; Even Spd Wave is one way to get Grado Poleax's effect going, while Seal Spd will be able to deal with all of the new speedy infantry units that are constantly getting released.
